cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

mechanism: A reclaims separation as its successful lesson in independence while adapting its reunion request to B independent plans.
confusable: Not simply liking time apart: A revises its own earlier controlling teaching as preparation for B current autonomy.
comparison: Scheduling independence versus conversational turn taking.
seedUse: D89 year apart/Saturday/pottery/Monday; S05 claims credit for outgrowing compulsory practice.
